propositions.statement: For registered land, the register is conclusive evidence of the title of the owner as appearing on the register and of rights, privileges, appurtenances or burdens appearing thereon, subject to the statutory qualifications including actual fraud or mistake and the court's rectification jurisdiction.

The Registration of Title Act 1964 provides the statutory framework for registration of ownership and distinguishes classes of registered title, including absolute, qualified and possessory title for freehold land.
The register or registry map is not generally conclusive as to the boundaries or extent of registered land, subject to statutory mechanisms that can make specified boundaries conclusive.
